{{Quote|Something... or ''someone... zapped'' all of my spy-eyes!|O-625|<ref name="GW" />}}
'''Zapper panels''' were anti-surveillance devices that could be built into walls. When activated they attracted small [[Security droid/Legends|spy drones]], such as [[AC1 surveillance droid]]s, and then destroyed them. A zapper panel was installed in the storefront of a miraponics shop on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]].
